summary: Umpqua NF site in Douglas County, OR, cleared for a lookout with no structure built; the directory lists it only as a patrol lookout point.

facts.status_note: Site was cleared for a lookout, but the directory says no structure was built.

evidence.supports: Directory is a listing of Oregon lookouts
Site cleared for a lookout but no structure built; used as a patrol lookout point
evidence.quote: Used as a patrol lookout point. The site was cleared for a lookout but no structure built.

evidence.supports: Managing forest is the Umpqua National Forest

notes_for_editor: Only one source describes the site (the Forest Lookouts page). The brief has kind unknown; the wording fits the 'point' kind (bare lookout point), so the editor may set it. No status is set because the source says no structure was built. Cowhorn Mountain, a trail near OR 58 found in search, is a different feature and was not used. Story is at the 120-word floor because the evidence is one line.
